liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (3 reviews): Reviewer notes Jerry flubs some of the words in this opener; After the vocal jamming at the end, Lesh plays a slow heavy bass line resembling the 1980 Stranger jam [15][17][21]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Reviewer singles this out for nice playing [20]
- **The Music Never Stopped** (1 review): Reviewer says it ends weakly [20]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): The audience recording has a cut in this song [13]

## The recordings

- **gd1981-07-05.sbd.miller.109839.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 25 songs; 186 min; rated 4/5 by 10 [1]
- **gd81-07-05.sbd.miller.30648.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 25 songs; 186 min; rated 3.31/5 by 13 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the soundboard sounds excellent on their system; Soundboard is clean and full, with Lesh's bass well placed in the mix, unlike many boards of the period [15][17]
- **gd1981-07-05.152669.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 25 songs; 185 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd81-07-05.nak700.munder.9126.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 25 songs; 170 min; rated 4.33/5 by 12 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the recording decent; Audience recording has strong sound with balanced lows, highs and vocals, though it needs EQ tweaking to lower the pitch [13][14]
- **gd1981-07-05.175900.aud.bernstein.ackerman.noel.flac2496**: audience recording; 13 songs; 92 min [9]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says Jerry started strongly and kept the energy up throughout the show [12]
- Small terraced amphitheater with red clay, grass and trees around the edge, holding roughly 7,000; an intimate outdoor setting [21]
- Reviewer saw several Mid-West shows and rated this the best of them [12]
- Reviewer finds this show pale compared with the previous night, with flubs, strained vocals and uneven energy [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1981-07-05.sbd.miller.109839.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Reel -> Dat [1]. Also: Remaster of an earlier soundboard transfer, with pitch correction and seamless disc changes [1]
- **gd81-07-05.sbd.miller.30648.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [2]
- **gd1981-07-05.152669.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Jim Vita's Master Audience Cassette; Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony TC-D5M (Maxell UDXLII) [3]. Also: Master from Jim Vita, transferred by Charlie Miller; Nakamichi 300 source patches He's Gone, Drums and the Around & Around transition [3]
- **gd81-07-05.nak700.munder.9126.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording: Nak CM700's [5]
- **gd1981-07-05.175900.aud.bernstein.ackerman.noel.flac2496**: taped by Jon Bernstein; transferred by Transfer, Mastering by Ray Ackerman Edited, Processed w/ add'l Mastering by Joe Noel December 21, 2025; source: ?? mics > ?? lead deck > Sony TC-D5 > Master Cassettes (Maxell XLIIS-90's) [9]. Also: Audience recording by Jon Bernstein, transferred by Ray Ackerman; taper was front-of-board and centered; Vita source supplied patches [9]
